summary: SKU↔Solution mapping + entitlement gating feature tested end-to-end. All 8 backend tests pass and frontend UI elements render correctly. Lock banner, link-skus-btn (admin/owner only), Unlock SKUs modal with sku-opt-L1 checkbox and sku-save-btn verified on mobile viewport (390x844).
action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: 'harden_1777921741@example.com' DOES own an L1 entitlement (`unlocked_via='L1'`) — the file claims 'NO L1-L4 entitlements'. This caused initial test failures until a fresh user was registered. Either reset this user's entitlements or correct the doc to say 'owns L1' so future tests register a fresh user for locked-view paths.
critical_code_review_comments: solutions_store.py is ~1140 lines — consider splitting (mapping helpers + ReviewNet aggregation are large mixed concerns).
Helper `_enrich_sku_lock` is correctly idempotent and pure; admin/owner/entitled bypass logic matches spec.
PUT /solutions-store/solutions/{id} correctly uppercases linked_sku_codes and is gated to owner OR role in [super_admin, co_admin, admin] (non-owner regular user → 403, verified).
seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway user (sku_ui_<timestamp>@example.com) for the regular-user locked-view path; created and deleted one TEST_owner_lock_bypass_sku_iter57 PRIVATE solution; mapped+cleared L1 on the Apollo Hospitals seed solution (7d16a88f-...). All mappings cleared at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter57_sku_solution_mapping.py registers a fresh user each run (the documented 'regular' user already owns L1). Frontend testIDs used: link-skus-btn (admin/owner header pricetags icon), sku-opt-{CODE}, sku-save-btn. Use mobile viewport 390x844 and pass the WhatsApp gate by POST /api/auth/whatsapp/send-otp → /verify-otp with the returned dev_code (WA_OTP_EXPOSE_DEV_CODE=true).
rca_of_issue: Initial 3 test failures (regular-user locked view, detail locked view, apply-to-option block) were not a backend defect — they stemmed from the documented test user harden_1777921741@example.com actually owning an L1 entitlement (`unlocked_via='L1'` confirmed via GET /solutions-store/solutions). Fix applied to the test fixture: register a fresh user with zero entitlements. After this fix, all 8 tests pass and lock/unlock behaviour matches the PRD.
